agent_report.reasoning: The source panel supports the isolated markers in the proposal, but several crowded low-pressure candidates are duplicate detections or black line artifacts rather than distinct marker centers. The red 303K low-pressure branch is a continuous thick stroke without separately visible circle centers, so no unsupported additions are made. The black 373K candidates below 30 kPa lie on the thick connecting stroke and have no visible plus glyphs. Three magenta pairs and one green pair collapse to single visible markers, and the blue 333K candidate near 102 kPa is a duplicate of the neighboring visible marker.

series.label: CO2 353K

series.label: CO2 373K
series.comment: Removed nine candidates lying on the thick black connecting stroke below 30 kPa; visible plus markers begin near 33 kPa.
